J U D G M E N T
Criminal Appeal no. 12/2013 2 Of page 7 This is an appeal filed by the appellant for setting aside

the
order dated 01.11.2012 (in short, referred to as the impugned order) passed by Sh. Bishan Chander

,
Adjudicating Officer/ADM, Distt. North West, Nand Nagri, Delhi.

2 Briefly stated facts of the present case are that on 26.08.2011 at about 4.00 PM Food Safety Officer Sh. D.V.Singh purchased a sample of "Rice" of 04 Kg from the shop of Sh. Ram Kumar Goel in his presence.

The sample was taken on the direction of Sh. K.K.Mittal, Designated Officer and all the necessary documents alongwith the Panchnama were prepared in the presence of Sh. Ram Kumar Goel by Food Safety Officer Sh. D. V. Singh.
3 On analyzing the sample by the Public Analyst, the sample taken was found to be unsafe because it is insect infested with living an dead insects.
The sample contained 8.38 per cent of damaged grains whereas it Criminal Appeal no. 12/2013 3 Of page 7 should not be more than 5 per cent by weight.

The total of the foreign matter and damaged grain shall not exceed 6 per cent by weight where as in the sampled article of food there quantity was found as 8.38 per cent which makes the sample substandard in violation of standards of " Rice" laid down under Regulation No. 2.4.6.5 of chapter 2 of the food safety and standards (Food Products and Food Additives) Regulation 2011.

5 On filing of complaint the ld.
ADM summoned the accused and after hearing the arguments passed the impugned order dated 1.11.2012 imposing fine of Rs. 50,000/ against respondent / accused Ram Kumar Goel.
Criminal Appeal no. 12/2013 4 Of page   6 Aggrieved from the impugned order present appeal is preferred by  Sh. Virender Kumar Goel son of appellant/respondent Sh. Ram Kumar Goel.

It is stated that order imposing the fine of Rs. 50,000/ is in violation of the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act Ram Kumar Goel (Missing) vs State on 25 September, 2013 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173099301/

sentences.text: It is further stated that it was brought to the notice of Adjudicating Officer by Sh. Virender Goel, son of Ram Kumar Goel that Sh. Ram Kumar Goel is missing since 12.8.2012.

The appellant has prayed for setting aside the impugned order and return of fine amount deposited by Sh.
Virender Goel son of Sh. Ram Kumar Goel ( accused ).
7

I have heard Sh.R.D.Goel, Ld. Counsel for the appellant and Sh. Rattan Negi, Ld. APP for respondent.
8

Sh. R.D.Goel, Ld. Counsel for the appellant has submitted that the sample collected was from the possession of Sh. Ram Kumar Goel father of Sh. Virender Kumar Goel and the sample taken is not from the possession of the appellant and the Ld. ADM has wrongly imposed fined of Rs.50,000/
Criminal Appeal no. 12/2013 5 Of page 7 against the Ram Kumar Goel.

9. On the other hand, Ld. APP Sh. Rattan Negi has vehemently opposed the contention of the appellant and submitted that as per Public Analyst Report there are insects in the sample and the court below has rightly imposed the fine of Rs.50,000/ and further submits that there is no infirmity in the impugned order and prays that the appeal of the appellant be dismissed with cost.
10 Perusal of the record shows that the sample of the "Rice" was stated to be taken from the Proprietorship shop of one Sh. Ram Kumar Goel in his presence on 26.08.2011.
As per the appeal file order was communicated to said Sh. Ram Kumar Goel on 8.11.2012.
As per the lower Court order sheet, the last order sheet recorded is of dated 16.10.2012.
There is no order sheet subsequent to the date of 16.10.2012.
As per order sheet dated 16.10.2012 a fine of Rs. 50,000/ is already been imposed.
There is no explanation on record how the fine of Rs. 50,000/ is imposed on Criminal Appeal no. 12/2013 6 Of page 7 the said Ram Kumar Goel vide subsequent order dated 1.11.2012.

Therefore, I set aside the order dated 1.11.2012 and consequently I also set aside order dated 16.10.2012 and remand back the case to the Court of Ld. ADM with the directions to pass fresh appropriate order after hearing the parties.

Parties are directed to appear before the Court of Ld.
ADM on 18.11.2013.
ANNOUNCED IN THE OPEN COURT ON THIS DAY OF 25th September, 2013.

(I.S. MEHTA)
 District & Sessions Judge   New Delhi Criminal Appeal no. 12/2013 7 Of  Ram Kumar Goel (Missing) vs State on 25 September, 2013 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173099301/
